summary: Roadmap item 5 of dimension32-global-topology: transition data, structure group, invariants and equivalence classes of the kernel bundles ker L_y over the smooth pieces of D_(5,12), starting from the kernel symmetry group, run as a Codex program.

reconciliation.note: Captured context; triage and evidence review pending.

scope: Evidence bundle docs/evidence/a5-kernel-bundles (scripts, result.json, README, ledger) and the program file docs/design/a5-kernel-bundles-program.md; nullity >= 12 orbits first, nullity 8 as stretch. Attachments, global model and uniform structure (items 6-8) stay out of scope.
next_action: Codex (gpt-daybreak-blue-latest, xhigh) in tmux pursues the program file; the orchestrator reviews each local commit, answers owner decisions recorded as BLOCKED in the ledger, and opens the pull request.

steps.action: Compute the Lie algebra of the real group K transporting ker L_y, test which directions of G_2(C) x SO(2, C) x C^* lift, and the K-orbit dimensions on each nullity >= 12 orbit.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a direction claimed to lift fails kernel transport at any representative, or a claimed non-lifting direction transports kernels.

steps.action: Give kernel frames polynomial or rational in (z, conj z) on each nullity >= 12 orbit with their degeneracy loci.
steps.acceptance: Fails if L_y x != 0 for a frame vector, or the frame loses rank at an orbit point outside the stated locus.

steps.action: Determine pi_1 and the cohomology needed for the invariants of the unit sections of B9, V, VB, V^a_+- and N_+-.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a stated group disagrees with an explicit fibration or homogeneous-space computation.

steps.action: Build an exact atlas of kernel frames over each smooth piece of D_(5,12), verify the cocycle on overlaps and identify the structure group.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a transition function fails the cocycle identity exactly or leaves the stated structure group.

steps.action: Compute characteristic classes and monodromy and decide triviality or identification with named bundles.
steps.acceptance: Fails if an invariant contradicts an explicit global section or frame.

steps.action: Independent verification, critical review and a claim for confirmed results only, through a pull request and the Codex review loop.
steps.acceptance: research_state.py --check and plan_tracker.py check pass and the four pr.yml checks are green on the PR head.
